entities.summary: Vladimir Stepanovich Ikonnikov or Volodymyr Stepanovych Ikonnykov was a historian in Imperial Russia and Soviet Ukraine specializing in study of historiography. Ikonnikov was an academician of the Saint Petersburg Academy of Sciences, a professor and a dean of the History and Philology faculty of Kiev University, and an academic at the All-Ukrainian Academy of Sciences.
